verdict.rationale: Motion has a live REST API with a version segment in its path: a probe of api.usemotion.com/v1/tasks returned a structured 401, and the docs reference a complete endpoint guide. That versioning is only implied by the URL, and nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme, changelog, or deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit versioning or compatibility policy, a changelog or sunset timelines, and independent corroboration of version stability.
